description: Normalize messy text: collapse repeated spaces, strip trailing whitespace and invisible characters, unify line endings, and optionally collapse blank lines, convert smart punctuation to ASCII, or remove URLs. Runs entirely offline — nothing is uploaded and no network call is made.

collapseBlankLines.description: Collapse runs of two or more blank lines into a single blank line.

normalizeQuotes.description: Replace curly quotes, en/em dashes and ellipsis characters with their ASCII equivalents.

removeUrls.description: Strip every http/https URL from the text. Note: this removes ALL URLs — the server is offline and cannot tell a working link from a dead one.

name: clean_text

changed.description: False when the input was already clean.

removedUrls.description: URLs stripped, when removeUrls was set.

title: Clean and normalize text
